mapper.insert: insert into problem_gt_candidate (project_id, source_run_key, candidate_id, candidate_key, note_no, note_name, folder, source, bucket, risk, recommended_action, suggested_issue_type, reason, candidate_kind, priority, period_bucket, table_path, section_path, row_label, column_label, period_label, source_value, target_value, missing_cells, missing_values, current_gt_overlap, current_final_hint, manual_decision, manual_rationale, source_locator, target_locator, pdf_context, raw_payload_json, created_at, updated_at) values (#{projectId}, #{sourceRunKey}, #{candidateId}, #{candidateKey}, #{noteNo}, #{noteName}, #{folder}, #{source}, #{bucket}, #{risk}, #{recommendedAction}, #{suggestedIssueType}, #{reason}, #{candidateKind}, #{priority}, #{periodBucket}, #{tablePath}, #{sectionPath}, #{rowLabel}, #{columnLabel}, #{periodLabel}, #{sourceValue}, #{targetValue}, #{missingCells}, #{missingValues}, #{currentGtOverlap}, #{currentFinalHint}, #{manualDecision}, #{manualRationale}, #{sourceLocator}, #{targetLocator}, #{pdfContext}, #{rawPayloadJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

insert into problem_gt_candidate (project_id, source_run_key, candidate_id, candidate_key, note_no, note_name, folder, source, bucket, risk, recommended_action, suggested_issue_type, reason, candidate_kind, priority, period_bucket, table_path, section_path, row_label, column_label, period_label, source_value, target_value, missing_cells, missing_values, current_gt_overlap, current_final_hint, manual_decision, manual_rationale, source_locator, target_locator, pdf_context, raw_payload_json, created_at, updated_at) values
(#{candidate.projectId}, #{candidate.sourceRunKey}, #{candidate.candidateId}, #{candidate.candidateKey}, #{candidate.noteNo}, #{candidate.noteName}, #{candidate.folder}, #{candidate.source}, #{candidate.bucket}, #{candidate.risk}, #{candidate.recommendedAction}, #{candidate.suggestedIssueType}, #{candidate.reason}, #{candidate.candidateKind}, #{candidate.priority}, #{candidate.periodBucket}, #{candidate.tablePath}, #{candidate.sectionPath}, #{candidate.rowLabel}, #{candidate.columnLabel}, #{candidate.periodLabel}, #{candidate.sourceValue}, #{candidate.targetValue}, #{candidate.missingCells}, #{candidate.missingValues}, #{candidate.currentGtOverlap}, #{candidate.currentFinalHint}, #{candidate.manualDecision}, #{candidate.manualRationale}, #{candidate.sourceLocator}, #{candidate.targetLocator}, #{candidate.pdfContext}, #{candidate.rawPayloadJson}, #{candidate.createdAt}, #{candidate.updatedAt})
mapper.select: select count(*) as total_count, sum(case when c.risk = 'high' then 1 else 0 end) as high_count, sum(case when c.risk = 'medium' then 1 else 0 end) as medium_count, sum(case when c.risk = 'manual_reused' then 1 else 0 end) as manual_reused_count, sum(case when c.bucket in ('covered_by_source_gt_index', 'maybe_covered_by_current_final', 'pdf_value_maybe_covered') then 1 else 0 end) as covered_count, sum(case when c.bucket = 'locked_confirmed_skip' then 1 else 0 end) as locked_count, sum(case when c.bucket = 'low_confidence_pdf_extra_value_pool' then 1 else 0 end) as pdf_low_count, sum(case when d.decision is null then 1 else 0 end) as undecided_count, sum(case when d.decision = 'ADD_TO_FINAL' then 1 else 0 end) as add_count, sum(case when d.decision = 'EXCLUDE' then 1 else 0 end) as exclude_count, sum(case when d.decision = 'DUPLICATE' then 1 else 0 end) as duplicate_count, ( select source_run_key from problem_gt_candidate where project_id = #{projectId} order by updated_at desc, id desc limit 1 ) as latest_source_run_key from problem_gt_candidate c left join problem_gt_decision d on d.project_id = c.project_id and d.candidate_key = c.candidate_key where c.project_id = #{projectId} and c.source_run_key = ( select latest.source_run_key from ( select source_run_key from problem_gt_candidate where project_id = #{projectId} order by updated_at desc, id desc limit 1 ) latest )

if.test: decision != null and decision != '' and decision != 'UNDECIDED'

sql.if: and ( c.candidate_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.folder like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.row_label like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.column_label like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.source_value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.target_value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.reason like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.manual_rationale like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or replace(replace(replace(lower(coalesce(c.row_label, '')), ' ', ''), '/', ''), '：', '') like concat('%', #{normalizedKeyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
select c.*, d.decision as decision, d.issue_type as decision_issue_type, d.comment as decision_comment, d.reviewer as reviewer, d.reviewed_at as reviewed_at, d.updated_at as decision_updated_at from problem_gt_candidate c left join problem_gt_decision d on d.project_id = c.project_id and d.candidate_key = c.candidate_key where c.project_id = #{projectId}
order by case c.risk when 'high' then 1 when 'medium' then 2 when 'manual_reused' then 3 when 'low' then 4 when 'skip' then 5 else 6 end, case c.bucket when 'high_confidence_possible_missing' then 1 when 'medium_confidence_possible_missing' then 2 when 'manual_confirmed_add_check_final' then 3 when 'manual_optional_or_dedup' then 4 when 'maybe_covered_by_current_final' then 5 else 9 end, case when c.note_no regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(c.note_no as unsigned) else 999999 end, c.note_no, c.priority, c.id

select c.*, d.decision as decision, d.issue_type as decision_issue_type, d.comment as decision_comment, d.reviewer as reviewer, d.reviewed_at as reviewed_at, d.updated_at as decision_updated_at from problem_gt_candidate c left join problem_gt_decision d on d.project_id = c.project_id and d.candidate_key = c.candidate_key where c.project_id = #{projectId} and c.source_run_key = #{sourceRunKey} order by case when d.decision is null then 9 else 1 end, case d.decision when 'ADD_TO_FINAL' then 1 when 'CHANGE_TYPE' then 2 when 'TABLE_MERGE' then 3 when 'DUPLICATE' then 4 when 'EXCLUDE' then 5 when 'NEED_RECHECK' then 6 when 'PENDING' then 7 else 8 end, case when c.note_no regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(c.note_no as unsigned) else 999999 end, c.note_no, c.priority, c.id
